props.name: open
props.description: Whether the drawer is shown. Set on Drawer.Root. Hold it in state and pass onOpenChange so the list can close the drawer.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new open state when the drawer asks to open or close, for example on overlay click or Escape. Set on Drawer.Root and use it to update the state behind open.

props.name: modal
props.description: Whether the drawer blocks the page behind it. Set on Drawer.Root. Set it to false for a drawer that sits beside the page; forceWithOverlay then adds the backdrop back.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading of the drawer, set on Drawer.Header. It also names the drawer for assistive technology, so always pass it.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting line under the title, set on Drawer.Header. Add it when it helps the person understand the drawer.

props.name: tagline
props.description: Small line above the title, such as a breadcrumb or category. Set on Drawer.Header.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon shown beside the title, set on Drawer.Header. Pass an IconV2 name, or { logo: name } for a logo.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons shown in the header, set on Drawer.Header. Put the form's own actions in Drawer.Footer, not here.

props.name: hideClose
props.description: Hides the header's close button. Set on Drawer.Header. Do this instead of adding a second close button.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Shows a loading placeholder in the header while the entity loads. Set on Drawer.Header.

props.name: scrollable
props.description: Whether Drawer.Body scrolls its own content. Set it to false only when the content manages its own scrolling.

props.name: size
props.description: Panel width, set on Drawer.Content. Pick the smallest size that fits the widest field. Don't set width through className or style.

props.name: direction
props.description: Edge the drawer opens from. Set on Drawer.Root, not Drawer.Content.

props.name: overlayClassName
props.description: Classes for the backdrop overlay. Drawer.Content only.

props.name: forceWithOverlay
props.description: Shows the backdrop overlay on a non-modal drawer. Drawer.Content only.

props.name: staticStackWidth
props.description: Keeps this drawer at its own width when another drawer opens on top, instead of shrinking. Drawer.Content only.
